comparison_only: Whole-crop trial for review; preserve historical T01 acceptance and source evidence. No T02+ or manufacturing approval.
computational_envelope: Union of immutable native core and inscribed polygonal buffer at the declared analytic radius. KEEP uses exact source core. Native polygon angular phase must not cause source shaving or a relaxed containment epsilon.
counterfactual: For each later companion, restore only one earlier grown neighbor to original core; fixed target radius, other neighbors, ports, group and settings. Save changed geometry and context revision.
factor: Each group min(1.5, member priority source-feasible round factors, A-square/B-envelope group bound). Co-reserve interacting priorities by proportional reduction of both groups growth increments; only decrease factors. All members keep same factor. Negligible growth <=safety becomes KEEP group.
grouping: Preserve reviewed pair first. Remaining disjoint competition pairs greedily by normalized center distance then stable IDs; unmatched sites are singletons. No transitive whole-crop common factor.
owner_tentative_approval: I will tentatively approve this. but plz apply the latest developed processing over the T01 crop to see what we get so that I can further decide if we are close to the pass point.
port_rule: Fixed source-existing segment/arc contact zones using own cap 1.5*r0; no blanket same-component exemption.
priority: One source-qualified round priority per complete original physical component: largest circle, stable source ID tie-break. Existing source trace ports only. All priorities co-reserved before companions.
schedule: All priorities ascending source ID first, then remaining sites ascending source centroid Y,X,ID. Atomic live updates and rebuilt STRtree per acceptance.
static: Same source, targets, order, factors, priorities grown and reserved, ports and buffers; companion neighbors frozen at source. Only accepted companion updates differ.
